# LP05 fixture grows alongside providers. Format is intentionally declarative.
root project representative.renegade
root scene Content/Scenes/Startup.wiscene
provider project project.startup_scene Content/Scenes/Startup.wiscene
provider project project.startup_flow Content/Flow/Main.renegade-flow
provider project project.startup_screen Content/UI/Main.renegade-screen
provider story-flow story_flow.level[0].scene_path_hint Content/Scenes/Startup.wiscene
provider story-flow story_flow.level[1].scene_path_hint Content/Scenes/Secondary.wiscene
provider runtime-screen runtime_screen.image[0].resource Content/UI/background.png
provider runtime-screen runtime_screen.font[0].resource Content/UI/missing-font.ttf
provider declared-reference script.declared_dependency[0] Content/Scripts/shared.lua
expect scene Content/Scenes/Secondary.wiscene
expect screen Content/UI/Main.renegade-screen
expect missing Content/UI/missing-font.ttf
reject outside ../outside-project.txt
reject metadata Content/Looks/like-a-path.png
collision Content/Textures/Stone.png Content/Textures/stone.png
